name: Hanling: Beiqi Liumin Lu
source:
China, 576 AD. As the Northern Qi dynasty approaches its collapse, war, famine, and corruption have made human life frighteningly cheap.
After losing his family, a young boy named Shen Jianci is rescued from human traffickers by Su Ninghan, a mysterious traveling performer. He joins her troupe, unaware that their intertwined pasts conceal secrets far darker than he could imagine.
